english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 3(26) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
english.pointstoprove: date and locationwithout reasonable excuse,in an emergency, when required to do so by a constable, airport official or Liverpool Airport Limited, failed to evacuate or remain in a building or place at Liverpool John Lennon Airport

english.notes: Byelaw 1(3) states that the offence will not be committed by any member of a fire, police or ambulance service acting in the course of their duty or to any emergency vehicle being used by such a person.
